title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT
entities.description: A NAS message that may be discarded by the MME if not delivered due to lower layer indication of non-delivery.

entities.name: MME
entities.description: Mobility Management Entity that may discard the DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message upon non-delivery indication.

entities.name: Lower layer indication of non-delivered NAS PDU
entities.description: Condition where the lower layer indicates that a NAS PDU was not delivered.

relations.description: The condition of non-delivered NAS PDU may cause the MME to discard the message.
The MME may discard the DOWNLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message upon non-delivery indication.
